title: TsCheckConfig
description: Configuration schema for @masumdev/tscheck code audit engine

$schema.description: URL or relative path to the tscheck JSON Schema for IDE autocomplete and validation.

rootDir.description: Root directory for auditing. Defaults to current working directory (process.cwd()).

workspaces.description: List of workspace glob patterns or directory paths (e.g. ["packages/*", "apps/*"]).

exclude.description: List of directory patterns to ignore during file discovery.

staged.description: Only scan files currently staged in Git.

since.description: Only scan files changed since a specific git branch or commit reference (e.g. "main").

fix.description: Automatically fix safe issues like prefixing unused variables/parameters with an underscore.

format.description: Output format for CLI stdout ("pretty", "json", "github", or "ai").

serve.description: Start a local HTTP server to view the HTML report.

open.description: Automatically open the HTML report in the default web browser.

port.description: Port number for the local HTML report server.

editor.description: Default editor scheme for clicking file locations in reports.

ai.description: Output token-efficient AI prompt markdown format.

rules.description: Audit rules configuration to enable or disable specific checks.

deprecated.description: Detects usages of functions, methods, classes, and properties tagged with JSDoc @deprecated.

unused.description: Detects unused variables, parameters, and imports.

noExplicitAny.description: Flags explicit any type annotations, assertions (as any), and generics.

circular.description: Detects circular module dependency cycles across files.

reporters.description: Report output settings for JSON, Markdown, HTML, AI, and CI artifacts.

outputDir.description: Output directory for audit report files.

serve.description: Start a local HTTP server to view the HTML report.

open.description: Automatically open the HTML report in the default web browser.

port.description: Port number for the local HTML report server.

editor.description: Default editor scheme for clicking file locations in reports.

githubAnnotations.description: Emit GitHub Actions workflow annotations (::warning, ::error) to stdout.

jsonFileName.description: Custom file name for the JSON report (without path).

markdownFileName.description: Custom file name for the Markdown report (without path).

htmlFileName.description: Custom file name for the HTML report (without path).

aiFileName.description: Custom file name for the AI prompt file (without path).

failOnWarning.description: Exit with code 1 if any warnings or deprecations are found.

tsconfigName.description: Custom tsconfig file name to search for across workspaces.
